decisions: The new complete local search/source/report test fails before and passes after the repair. The exact Unicode/punctuation query is preserved, each destination loads once, all three journals are verified, no click/key/input event is posted into the page and re-entering the completed task replays nothing.

All thirteen navigation authority variants reject with zero destination requests; only the explicit late-source-revocation case reaches its final pre-dispatch callback. One browser window is retained across the cases until explicit Close.

The new focus-recovery fixture rejects Select All after the captured field loses focus, with zero attempted input or page events. Fresh native click, Select All and exact Unicode insertion then succeed with one edit; old authority remains unusable. This proves controlled recovery, not the precise cause of the preceding movie03 stale-agent-point.

Existing exact search/navigation, replay/cancellation/revocation, login/early Resume and source-rejection/uncertain-redirect regressions pass. Strict stale-completion and wait tests pass after correcting the obsolete fixture expectation.

The Q6 full movie04 retry still fails after twelve proposals and 183.307358 seconds. Five native navigations verify. One search proposal is rejected across an observed Bing redirect, and three clicks are rejected before effect. It hands back under the unchanged cumulative four-rejection bound with lastAgentTargetStatus stale-agent-link.

One retained screenshot shows irrelevant dictionary results for a restricted film query. The final screenshot instead shows the correct official Roxie Ticket Info result. The final proposed normalized point [81,448] lies visibly on that result label; native point validation reaches the later link-binding rejection. Do not call this last failure a demonstrated grounding miss.

Next isolate stale-agent-link into its existing individual checks, then use a controlled no-inference link reproduction and a short public read-only probe if necessary. The present diagnostic does not distinguish retirement, base/signature, navigation kind, fragment identity, layout or label/destination mismatch. Do not relax link identity or raise the retry budget based on a generic status.

All twelve sequential model workers exit and remove temporary credentials. Peak sampled max(RSS,physical footprint) is 5002379264 bytes under the diagnostic 5 GiB cap. No ticket selection occurs. No total application memory, thermal or production qualification is claimed.

Eight build/test bundles are retained: five passing and three failing (the intended navigation red, obsolete completion expectation, and incomplete movie task). There is no compiler-only failure or runtime-warning result in this checkpoint; existing Swift compile warnings remain.
